notes: v0.18.6: Four floating usability upgrades: tap a separate draggable-bubble-adjacent OSC PTT button to hold/release without expanding the panel; quick Live Chatbox start/pause/resume/stop, authorized official-only selector and direct one-tap sends for up to four saved phrases; pinned friend profiles with fast Social and invitation links; and a configurable 0-3-action bar fixed above long scrolled pages in addition to the existing six Home shortcuts. The PTT latch has a dedicated low-latency worker and retains five-minute and exit-release safeguards. All previous v0.18.5 official-only chatbox, world bookmarks, Mini-VRCX, moderation/Node/OSC utilities and staff authorization are preserved. No Main Launcher or Relay update required.
